scope: Independent narrow review of ordinary O_RDONLY CreateAuthorizedSnapshot and the proposed four-case owned host fixture. This is not runtime qualification or full Registry/service review.

findings.assessment: AuthorizeCreate checks the already active handle/token/pair, kernel sender identity, retained subject snapshot and held caller task before marking this slot busy. The new maker uses only that returned authority and the received input descriptors. It does not establish a new approval, authorize a different grant, or send a response.

Every path after successful AuthorizeCreate reaches FinishCreate. Maker-local descriptors are RAII owned. A failed final check closes any newly returned output before the same owner revokes this handle. Close uses OwnThread rather than the poisoned Owner gate, so the same owner can revoke after credential poisoning; foreign process/thread ownership cannot mutate through this cleanup path. If creation already failed its errno remains the first error; otherwise the finish error is returned. Inputs remain owned by Received.

The source fd is compared with the canonical subject maps inode through its held proc authority. Sealed input metadata, owner, size and access flags are checked. A real root-owned memfd receives the bounded payload, V2 provenance xattr, mode 0444 and required seals; the reopened output is checked for inode, seals, status flags, CLOEXEC, offset and exact tag before publication. Origin statfs comes directly from SYS_fstatfs into the asserted 120-byte KernelStatfs; all fields including flags and spare words are encoded without libc ST_VALID normalization. StoreMetadata is exactly identical to pinned V2; the complete maker delta exactly matches the supplied authority-only diff.

The proposed cases are valid creation, wrong source, unsealed input and size mismatch. Each negative uses actual received FDs, expects rejection and then performs a valid create on that same grant, so a leftover busy transaction would reject the follow-on create. The positive compares source stat fields and every raw statfs byte against independent kernel queries, verifies sealed root output and fixed owned payload, transfers it to the exact role child, and receives its independent verification ACK. This is a fixed owned formatter payload, not commercial maps formatting or platform policy.

Default or invalid invocation returns PLAN_ONLY before Registry initialization, root checks, fork or namespace work; only literal --execute-once enters the four-case path. The included old entry is renamed and not invoked. Each case forks one owned child, binds its PIDFD, checks the actual begin identity, and normally joins that exact child; failure cleanup uses its owned PIDFD/child and is counted. Final PASS requires four normal reaps, zero forced or unreaped cleanup and restored descriptor count. No listener/service, Main operation, Android runtime, or pressure workload is introduced.

retained_limitations.detail: The inherited reopen uses the original source F_GETFL flags. O_NOFOLLOW is retained and can make reopening /proc/thread-self/fd/N fail with ELOOP. The fixture deliberately covers ordinary O_RDONLY; this review does not fix or qualify O_NOFOLLOW.

Wrong-source/unsealed/size cases exercise maker failure followed by successful FinishCreate and same-grant reuse. They do not force FinishCreate itself to fail after a successfully created output or force Owner poisoning. The close/revoke branch was read, not executed by this reviewer.

No snapshot positive runtime, root fixture, compile, default PLAN binary, Android, live commercial process, full service response lifecycle or immutable pre-guest policy was run by this reviewer. Previously retained Registry positives do not become snapshot positives. Caller-side authenticated bounded reply/revoke remains outside this entry.

The maker checks its two-second monotonic deadline per payload iteration; the fixture has bounded waits and an outer deadline. This source review does not assert hard wall-clock preemption of individual syscalls or cleanup.

author_evidence_scope: Frozen local compile/default PLAN receipts are retained author evidence only; not re-executed or represented as this reviewer's execution.
